Hosting Services Agreement, April 5, 2011
Example Hosting, Inc. hosts the KitchenGrid service for $1,850 per month.
Initial term: 12 months. It renews for further 12-month terms unless either side
gives 60 days written notice.
Backups run daily and are kept for 35 days.
Example Hosting may assign this agreement only with Harbor Labs' consent.
